article.title: Publication of rules.
article.content: Rules so made and 5[approved] shall be published in the 6[Official Gazette], and shall from the date of publication or from such other date as may be specified have the same force and effect, within the local limits of the jurisdiction of the High Court which made them, as if they had been contained in the First Schedule.
article.html:
127Publication of rules.

Section 127

Rules so made and 5[approved] shall be published in the 6[Official Gazette], and shall from the date of publication or from such other date as may be specified have the same force and effect, within the local limits of the jurisdiction of the High Court which made them, as if they had been contained in the First Schedule.

5 Subs. by Act 24 of 1917, s. 2 and Sch. I, for “sanctioned”.

6 Subs. by the A.O. 1937, for “Gazette of India or in the local Official Gazette, as the case may be”. Strictly the substitution would read “Official Gazette or in the Official Gazette, as the case may be, but the latter words have been omitted as being redundant”.
